content:
sophia: Heads up — nightly eval spiked for m21c-v2 after last rollout. CSV parsing errors up 14% on anchor promptset. Looks like final column missing for many samples. /cc @liam
nightly-bot: nightly-eval | m21c-v2 | 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC | regressions: CSV_PARSE_FAIL: +14.2% | BLEU: -0.6 | avg_len: -3.2
liam: ack. can you paste a failing example?
sophia: here's one from judge logs:
```
INPUT: "Summarize the table and include totals"
OUTPUT: "Date,Item,Qty\n2026-03-01,Widget A,10\n2026-03-02,Widget B,5"
EXPECTED: last column "Total" present
```
liam: hmm output missing trailing newline+total. Could be newer tokenizer treating `\n` boundary as EOS earlier. Did the tokenizer mapping change in m21c-v2?
derek: devnotes from model import say merge on subtokens changed: added special-case mapping for `\n` ->  token index 2 (previously 2001). That could shift offsets.
nina: also quant run used int8-legacy config for this rollout. I saw a smaller shift in generation length distribution in canary tests but didn't think it'd drop trailing tokens.
sophia: reproduction command:
```
python -m reproduce --model m21c-v2 --prompt-file fails.txt --seed 42 --max-tokens 64
```
liam: i'll run locally. quick check: can we look at token ids around newline for this model?
derek: dumped tokenizer mapping snippet:
```
"\\n": 1999  # previous
"": 2   # new
```
liam: that explains it. EOS moved to low index, and our decoding heuristics stop on id < 10 when using fastdecode in int8 path.
sophia: so int8 fastdecode uses <10 cutoff to avoid control tokens — now newline flagged as control and stops generation.
liam: quick mitigation: disable fastdecode for m21c-v2 quant builds or override stop-token list to not include newline.
nina: can we patch Canary bucket to run with stop-token override and rerun nightly?
sophia: set a canary job with env REDWOOD_DECODE_STRICT=false and re-run.
nightly-bot: queued rerun for canary (m21c-v2, override stop-list) — ETA 18m
liam: opened PR to exclude `\n` from stoplist in quant fastdecode: PR #4829
derek: also logging a model import note to revert newline->EOS mapping with model team; might be intentional for other usecases though.
sophia: great. after canary passes we'll decide whether to change decoding or ask model team revert token mapping.
liam: local run shows canary outputs include totals now. patch looks good. :thumbsup: 
nightly-bot: canary rerun completed — regressions reduced to CSV_PARSE_FAIL +0.8%
sophia: closing for now but leaving follow-up to docs + model import checklist. filing a follow-up ticket.
liam: ticket: ML-8783 — tokenizer mapping review + decode-policy guidance
nina: I'll add a note to quantization runbook about this edgecase.
sophia: thanks all. /resolve
